name: West Hartford Solar
old_description: West Hartford Solar was founded by Dan Hovey with one simple mission: to make solar accessible, personal and ethical. What started as a solo journey has grown into a regional team serving customers throughout New England.
about:
West Hartford Solar operates from West Hartford, Connecticut. The company was founded by Dan Hovey, who serves as owner and principal consultant, with a mission to make solar energy accessible, personal, and ethical. What began as a solo endeavor has expanded into a regional team serving customers across New England.

The firm functions as a licensed solar installer managing projects from design and permitting through installation and activation. It maintains installation crews in Connecticut and supplements coverage in Massachusetts through a partnership with Earthlight Technologies and in New York through New York State Solar Farm. The team includes senior consultants covering western Massachusetts, the Connecticut River Valley, southeastern Connecticut, and the northwestern hills.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to reduce energy costs to businesses, schools, nonprofits, and municipalities pursuing long-term sustainability goals. The company coordinates custom solar solutions for corporate facilities, housing authorities, and local government projects across Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New York.

Hovey started the business to provide transparent pricing, personalized guidance, and a stress-free experience, emphasizing honesty and responsiveness at every step. The company highlights access to multiple financing options and a commitment to tailoring each system to the specific property rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
